City Watch: The Lantern Files - fight sounds

Made for this game with tools/make-fight-sounds.py: synthesised layers (body thumps,
swishes, a plucked crossbow string, a metal ring, a spell shimmer, grit) mixed with
short slices of recordings already in the game:

Hammer on wood, Timber crack, Timber movement / fall - rubberduck. CC0 1.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Source: https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-metal-and-wood-sfx
Cloth movement 1-7 - OwlishMedia. CC0 1.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Source: https://opengameart.org/content/202-more-sound-effects

These sounds are released under CC0 1.0 as well.

punch-1..4     a fist landing (suspects, empty-hand force)
heavy-1..2     a troll's heavy swing landing
club-1..3      a truncheon blow
blade-1..2     a sword strike (flat of the blade)
swish-1..3     a swing that misses
block-1..2     a blow taken on Guard
guard-1        taking up Guard
shove-1..2     a shove
fall-1..2      someone going down
crossbow-1     a crossbow shot; bolt-1..2 the bolt landing
spell-1        a rogue wizard's dazzle
grit-1         thrown grit
bandage-1      a bandage
